slides.headline: Cartier's Tank Came From War
slides.credit: Photo: Guy Sie / CC BY-SA 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons. Modern Tank shown

slides.text: Louis Cartier created the Tank in 1917, inspired by Renault tanks on the Western Front.
slides.credit: Photo: Guy Sie / CC BY-SA 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

slides.text: The prototype case was 23 by 30 mm in platinum, with polished flanks.
slides.credit: Photo: Guy Sie / CC BY-SA 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

slides.text: Officers needed wrist timing to coordinate attacks, Monochrome Watches reports.
slides.credit: Photo: John Warwick Brooke / Public domain via Wikimedia Commons

slides.text: Introduced in 1918, full production began in 1919 with six pieces built.
slides.credit: Photo: Guy Sie / CC BY-SA 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

slides.text: The prototype went to General John J. Pershing of the American Expeditionary Force.
slides.credit: Photo: Bain News Service, publisher / Public domain via Wikimedia Commons

slides.text: A design born in a trench war still reads as formal. That is the Tank's trick.
slides.credit: Photo: U.S. Signal Corps / Public domain via Wikimedia Commons

slides.text: The Renault tanks Cartier saw on the Western Front inspired the watch.
slides.credit: Photo: Hohum / CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons
